::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 29th [1865]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/Cobweb-6[^1]
:::

My dear [Cobweb](people/person_675.qmd),
I should not have bothered you about your questions this month but that [Chelsea China](people/person_329.qmd) told me that your [Mother](people/person_1934.qmd) was so much better that she thought you would be able to do them or rather ask them- and as it is so we shall get the order of things right again.

I think the two [questions](organizations/other_104.qmd) that will make the most variety would be the history of the Knights’ [sic] Templars and the history of the Isle of Man. I am afraid this is a poorish [Barnacle](organizations/other_89.qmd) but I hope the next will be better

your affectionate

Mother Goose

---

[^1]: Cream envelope 68mm x 122mm with stamped mark Parkins & Gotto, Makers 24 & 25, Oxford Street and remains of flower embossed wafer, addressed to Miss Helmore/ 6 Cheyne Walk/ Chelsea/ SW, and postmarked Winchester 29 April 1865 and London 1 May 1865.
